span.p:
Kafka
3000 seat, 2 lakh log
-> darwaze pe ginti (Redis DECR): ~3000 andar, baaki line me
andar walo ki booking Kafka me, key = show_id: ek show ek worker, ek-ek UPDATE
(waiting room)
UPDATE jeeta -> user ko poll / push (bookingId)
seat haar gaya -> seat gayi, doosri lo
andar wala bina liye gaya -> line se agla andar
